description: Time freezes when trying to kick a villager out of a bed then breaking it i have attatched a video of the glitch and the log for that session it still loads chunks. Here is a video with the bug The game can also randomly freeze.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Place a bed and spawn a villager using `/summon minecraft:villager ~ ~ ~`.
3. Position the villager on top of the bed so that it starts sleeping there.
4. Approach the bed and try to kick the villager out by pressing the use key (default: E) while facing the villager.
5. Once the villager is kicked out, immediately break the bed using any tool or directly with your hand.
6. Observe if the game freezes at this point.
7. Note that chunks continue to load during the freeze.
8. Document whether the time appears frozen and observe for approximately 10 seconds.
9. Take a screenshot or record the behavior to document the freeze.
Observed Behavior: The game can randomly freeze when attempting to kick a villager out of a bed and then breaking it. During this sequence, time freezes, causing the player to be unable to interact with the environment or progress further within the game. This issue persists even though chunks continue to load normally. A video demonstrating the glitch has been attached along with the log from that session for reference. Additionally, the game can also freeze randomly under other circumstances, but this specific scenario involves the interaction with a villager and a bed.
Expected Behavior: When attempting to kick a villager out of a bed and then breaking it, the game should not freeze. The villager should be successfully kicked out of the bed, allowing you to break it without any issues. Time should continue to progress normally, and the game should remain responsive throughout these actions.
